name: uml-diagrams
description: Mermaid CLI renderer for UML diagrams

scripts.render: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('out',{recursive:true})" && mmdc -i architecture.mmd -o out/architecture.png && mmdc -i data-model.mmd -o out/data-model.png && mmdc -i auth-sequence.mmd -o out/auth-sequence.png && mmdc -i booking-flight-sequence.mmd -o out/booking-flight-sequence.png && mmdc -i booking-generic-sequence.mmd -o out/booking-generic-sequence.png && mmdc -i security.mmd -o out/security.png && mmdc -i simple-architecture.mmd -o out/simple-architecture.png && mmdc -i simple-data.mmd -o out/simple-data.png && mmdc -i simple-booking-sequence.mmd -o out/simple-booking-sequence.png
